[[Losai Hapatu]] is a collector, a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

==Locations==
*[[Shing Jea Island]]
**{{NPC location|Panjiang Peninsula}}

==Dialogue==
:''"Hello there. I have a bet with some friends of mine about which of us can collect the most impressive shell. Impressive, of course, means balanced...not too large and not too small. Hmm...now that i think about it, the shell from an adult kappa will win me this bet! If you help me I would be most grateful. In fact, if you bring me 4 Kappa Shells, I shall give you this in return:"''

==Trivia==
*The dialogue refers to a bet made by [[Junsu]], [[Hai Lae]], [[Xi Gai]], and Losai Hapatu about who could find the most impressive shell.
*This character's name, along with [[Louise Haup]], [[Losi Hapatu]] and [[Lohiz Hoput]] is much-likely a tribute to Lois Haupt, the Alpha Tester of [[Guild Wars]] campaigns and [[Nightfall]] Guidebook.
